title: Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar
paragraphs: A detective drama about freelance insurance investigator Johnny Dollar, whose expense-account narration carries him through fraud, theft, missing persons, and murder cases across several distinct starring eras.

CBS detective drama centered on freelance insurance investigator Johnny Dollar. GRH also preserves pre-series/role audition material, including Dick Powell (1948), John Lund daily-serial audition material (1952), and Gerald Mohr (1955). Specialist logs place episode 1 on 1949-02-11; some secondary references cite 1949-02-18 as the premiere, so the alternate convention is preserved in evidence notes.

GRH documents the program through Charles Russell era (February 11, 1949 to January 14, 1950) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], Edmond O'Brien era (February 3, 1950 to September 3, 1952) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], John Lund era (November 28, 1952 to September 19, 1954) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and Bob Bailey five-part serial era (October 3, 1955 to November 2, 1956) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are [[person|bob-bailey|Bob Bailey]] (performer on 446 recordings), Jack Johnstone (director on 360 recordings, producer on 276 recordings, and writer on 147 recordings), [[person|virginia-gregg|Virginia Gregg]] (performer on 277 recordings), Roy Rowan (announcer on 274 recordings and performer on 1 recording), Amerigo Moreno (music supervisor on 219 recordings, music on 5 recordings, and violin on 5 recordings), Lawrence Dobkin (performer on 122 recordings), and Forrest Lewis (performer on 119 recordings).

CBS detective drama centered on freelance insurance investigator Johnny Dollar. GRH also preserves pre-series/role audition material, including Dick Powell (1948), John Lund daily-serial audition material (1952), and Gerald Mohr (1955).
